test_advanced_package_override_simple: test the Hydra advanced package override for a single database package using run_python_script
test_advanced_package_override_two_packa: test the Hydra advanced package override for source and destination packages using run_python_script
run_python_script_with_hydra_overrides: run a Python script with Hydra config overrides like hydra.run.dir and hydra.job.chdir
create_omegaconf_from_result: create an OmegaConf config object from a string result returned by run_python_script
chdir_hydra_root: change the working directory to the Hydra project root before running tests
